title: (0Day) Microsoft Windows Update Assistant Directory Junction Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within Windows Update Assistant. By creating a directory junction, an attacker can abuse Windows Update Assistant to delete a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of Administrator.
